nodes.text:
Gavi:
- #HMPV is NOT a threat to global health yet.
- Most people recover on their own, young children, older adults, and immunocompromised at higher risk.
- No specific #antiviral treatment or #vaccine available; prevention measures similar to other respiratory viruses.
